crossRefs.note: Israel said to Joseph, “Behold, I am dying, but God will be with you, and bring you again to the land of your fathers.

translations.web: Pharaoh said, “Go up, and bury your father, just like he made you swear.”
translations.bsb: Pharaoh replied, “Go up and bury your father, as he made you swear to do.”
translations.kjv: And Pharaoh said, Go up, and bury thy father, according as he made thee swear.
translations.asv: And Pharaoh said, Go up, and bury thy father, according as he made thee swear.
